fields.label: Language
fields.description: en = English, ta = Tamil. The English template decides whether this event is sent on this channel at all. Recipients whose account language is Tamil get the Tamil template while it is enabled (and, for SMS, registered); everyone else gets the English one.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Jinja allowed. Used as the e-mail subject or the in-app notification title.

fields.label: Body
fields.description: Jinja template. Helpers: rupees(amount), format_inr(amount), fdate(date), fdatetime(datetime), short(text, length), label(value) (a status or category in this template's language). English SMS: keep under 160 characters in plain English and register the same wording on the DLT portal. Tamil SMS are sent as Unicode, 70 characters a part.

fields.label: DLT Template ID
fields.description: Content template ID from the DLT portal.

fields.label: MSG91 Flow Template ID
fields.description: Template ID of the MSG91 flow linked to this DLT template. When set, MSG91 sends its stored wording with these variables; when blank, the text above is sent with the DLT Template ID.

fields.label: WhatsApp Template Name
fields.description: Approved template name in WhatsApp Manager.

fields.label: Template Parameters
fields.description: One Jinja expression per line, in order. WhatsApp receives them as {{1}}, {{2}}…; MSG91 receives them as VAR1, VAR2… together with every context variable by name.

fields.label: Standard Wording Fingerprint
fields.description: Fingerprint of the wording as shipped. While it matches, upgrades may refresh the wording; once the template is edited it is never changed automatically.
